about: Whitby is a lakeshore town in Durham Region, between Ajax and Oshawa on Lake Ontario. It is a growing commuter municipality with a historic downtown inland from the harbour. GO Transit, Highway 401, and Highway 407 run through the town. About 140,000 people live in Whitby.
seoSummary: Durham Region lakeshore town between Ajax and Oshawa, with a historic downtown.
